contact.basis: Saxon DGM 1 m nadir on the central fortress plateau.

method: Bilinear sample of original native DGM1 pixel centres into the east/south frame. Four GeoTIFFs from Saxon 2017 survey. No flattening or architectural terrain modification.
limitations: A 2 metre model-local review grid may smooth a nearly vertical cliff within one cell; source tiles preserve original 1 metre samples.
